mentions.name: chckn
mentions.description: A loyalty and membership platform for small businesses that requires no app downloads, integrates with Apple/Google wallet, and provides analytics dashboards for merchants.
mentions.problem: Existing loyalty/membership products for small businesses are awful, as experienced firsthand by the co-founder who owns an ice cream shop.
mentions.audience: Small business merchants (e.g., the co-founder's ice cream shop) seeking loyalty and membership tooling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a loyalty/membership product for small businesses. My co-founder owns an ice cream shop and complained about how awful the existing products in this space, so we decided to build something better. No apps to download, Apple/Google wallet integration, and really cool analytics for the merchant.

evidence.value: I've been building a loyalty/membership product for small businesses.
